test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All bells are birds.

Some bells are toys.

**Conclusions:**

I. No bird is a toy.

II. Some toys are birds.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1da386ddc7b61557cab773d7628bfec3328232656cc8fe7123a9d1badd5e956d.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No bird is a toy. → Does not follow** **(As, All bells are birds and Some bells are toys → Some bird are toy)

II. Some toys are birds. → Follows (As, All bells are birds and Some bells are toys)

Hence, '**Only conclusion II follows**' is the correct answer.
